title: ladder-who5: WHO-5 well-being check and Ladder method question templates in Kazakh, Russian and English
description: Open part of 108psy.com, a free self-help diagnostic for women in Kazakhstan. Contains WHO-5 Well-Being Index scoring (rule-based, no AI), a static browser demo, and question templates of the Ladder method by Aizhan Li in Kazakh, Russian and English. The Russian and Kazakh WHO-5 wordings are working translations, not official validated versions. The score is not a diagnosis.
